sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Neutralizing your target is more effective without any noise, from a safe distance. The next test from Sniper is a practice in this kind of business. Get a suppressor and shoot experienced enemies from medium distances."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 5 PMCs while using a suppressed bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope
- 1× Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle
- Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant PRO) at Jaeger LL4
- Unlocks purchase of Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope at Jaeger LL4
"The enemy is absolutely helpless when they don't know where they get shot from. You did well, shooter."
